products.name: CLG Review Season Kit
products.summary: 300+ phrases, 5 conversation scripts and the templates you need to write fair, specific performance reviews, without the blank page.
description: Built for managers of all levels writing year-end reviews, and for anyone writing a self-evaluation. Every phrase follows one rule: describe what the person did, why it mattered, and what happens next.
Includes guidance for the hard cases: remote employees, top performers, people who are great at the job but hard to work with, former peers, a hard personal year, and reviews that may lead to a PIP.
This kit offers general guidance on writing reviews. It is not legal or HR advice.
includes: Quick start: how to use the kit, the formula and a 6-week review timeline
Phrase bank: 300 phrases across 10 skill areas and 3 rating levels
Special cases for remote employees, top performers, former peers and more
5 conversation scripts plus a 15-minute meeting agenda
Self-evaluation template with a filled-in example
Pre-submit checklist with words to avoid and a calibration cheat sheet

products.name: CLG Wrong Mode Course
products.summary: A course on leading, managing and mentoring: how to choose the right mode for the moment.
description: Leadership, management and mentoring are three modes one person switches between, often in the same week, not three separate roles. People rarely fail because they lack one of them. They fail because they use the wrong mode at the wrong moment, like mentoring someone who needed a clear decision.

Most people are promoted for being good at the work and trained only in the mechanics of management. This course builds leadership and mentoring deliberately, with a three-question diagnostic, exercises and discussion questions, and sources for every cited idea.
includes: Module 1: Three modes, not three roles
Module 4: Managing, including warning signs of over- and under-managing
Module 6: Putting the modes together, with a capstone
